description_text:
Italian Restaurant – Multiple Hospitality Positions | Dubai
 Our client, a leading luxury hotel in Dubai, is looking to recruit motivated hospitality professionals to join their Italian restaurant team.
 The restaurant has approximately 150 seats across indoor and outdoor areas and offers authentic Italian cuisine alongside a full beverage and alcohol service.
 Available Positions
 Food & Beverage Servers 
 Bartender 
 Hostess 
 Commis Chefs 
 Requirements
 Previous experience in a similar hospitality role is preferred.
 Good command of spoken English .
 Positive, professional, and guest-focused attitude.
 Ability to work in a fast-paced restaurant environment.
 For culinary positions, experience in Italian cuisine is an advantage.
 Internship and trainee opportunities are also available. 
 Package & Benefits
 Accommodation provided – shared accommodation, up to 3 people per room.
 Residence facilities including gym and swimming pool .
 Health and life insurance .
 Transportation provided between accommodation and workplace.
 6 days off per month .
 30 days annual leave per year .
 Visa costs covered by the company.
 Visa processing takes approximately 2–3 weeks .
 2-year employment contract for regular positions.
 Trainee programmes available from 6 months to 1 year. 
 📅 Expected start: Mid-November
 This is a great opportunity for hospitality professionals and trainees looking to gain international experience and build their career in Dubai within a luxury hotel environment.
